mentions.name: New Sudoku app
mentions.description: A new Sudoku app in its earliest stages, built to test new ideas the author wants to try after having reservations with sudoku.com's app; a prototype exists for testing planned features.
mentions.problem: Reservations with sudoku.com's existing app and new ideas the author wanted to try.
mentions.source_excerpt: been using sudoku.com's app for a while and have some reservations with it, and a few new ideas that i wanted to try, so building a new sodoku app. this is in its earliest stages. Have a prototype to test ideas i want to build in.
